title: Seed Search
description:
[h2]Find the seed you want, before you start the run.[/h2]
Adds a [b]Search Seed[/b] button to both the [b]Standard Run (Character Select)[/b] screen and the [b]Custom Run[/b] screen (singleplayer). Pick what you want from the game's own icons, and the multi-core Rust engine searches millions of seeds per second for it.

[h3]Filter by[/h3]
[list]
[*]Neow's offers, what they give when taken, and how each Neow choice changes the Floor 1 card reward
[*]Act 2 & Act 3 Ancients and the exact 3 relics they offer (Orobas, Pael, Tezcatara, Nonupeipe, Tanx, Vakuu, Darv)
[*]First Shop inventory (5 character cards + 50% On Sale card, 2 colorless cards, 3 shop relics, 3 potions)
[*]Treasure Chest relics and Shared/Player relic grab-bag order
[*]Which act you get, its boss (including Double Boss), and the order of events, fights and elites
[*]Single-path reachable Elites, Rest Sites, Shops and Unknowns on a legal route (or total map counts)
[*]OR ('Any Of') filter groups and 1-click filter addition with inline +/- steppers
[/list]

[h3]Preview any seed[/h3]
Neow's offers and post-Neow Floor 1 rewards, First Shop inventory, Treasure Chest relics, Act 2/3 Ancient relic offerings, every act's boss, ancient, events and fights, the relic bags, and the act maps — with active filter highlighting, hover tooltips, and one-click Copy Summary.

[h3]Keep what you find[/h3]
Bookmark seeds with a note, and come back to recent or kept searches. One click starts a seeded Standard Run or fills the Custom Run seed box.

[h3]Good to know[/h3]
[list]
[*]Seed search is singleplayer only. Starting from Character Select runs a normal Standard Run (keeping unlocks and achievements enabled).
[*]The fast search is Windows only; other platforms use a slower search.
[*]No dependencies.
[/list]

Unofficial fan-made mod, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
changeNote: v2.1.0: Updated for latest game patch parity; added Search Seed button to Standard Run (Character Select); added Act 2/3 Ancient relic offerings, First Shop inventory, Treasure Chest relics, Neow-coupled Floor 1 rewards, single-path reachable map counts, OR filter groups, 1-click filter addition with inline +/- steppers, active filter highlighting, and hover tooltips.
